userStories.title: Track sidecar session start and render total session elapsed in the dashboard header
userStories.description: As a cam operator running prolonged autonomous sessions, I need the dashboard to show how long the current sidecar session has been running so that I can judge when to stop the loop.
acceptanceCriteria: The sidecar records a session-start timestamp (sessionStartTs) once at process startup; it is stable across state-file rewrites and fresh-loop starts within the same sidecar session (a second loop in one session does not reset it). [oracle: bun test]
readSnapshot exposes the session start as an optional DashboardData field (e.g. sessionStartedAtMs); a missing or unreadable source leaves it undefined without throwing. [oracle: bun test]

The Dashboard Loop header renders a total-session elapsed row (formatWallClock), distinct from the existing since (last-activity) row; the row is omitted or shows a muted placeholder when the session start is unknown. [oracle: bun test test/dashboard.test.ts]
Verify the screen renders correctly (ink-testing-library; state is signalled by the glyph, never by divider color). [oracle: bun test]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Full quality spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
Vendor drift check passes (mandatory if templates/ or vendor/ are touched by the chosen mechanism; trivially green otherwise). [oracle: bun run embed-vendor:check]
userStories.notes: Files: src/commands/sidecar.ts and/or src/supervisor/host.ts (startup seam), src/commands/dashboard.ts (DashboardData + readSnapshot), src/ui/Dashboard.tsx (SummaryPanel), test/dashboard.test.ts, test/supervisor/. Gotchas: the state file started_at is NOT the session start; it resets on a fresh loop (src/commands/next.ts:327 writes now when no parsed state). The supervisor lock (.claude/.cam-supervisor.lock, src/supervisor/lock.ts; wired at src/supervisor/host.ts:395-419) records startedAt at lock acquisition; verify it spans the whole sidecar session before reusing it. If it is re-acquired per cycle, persist a dedicated once-per-process record from the sidecar entrypoint instead. readSnapshot is shared by the legacy composeDashboard (test-only path) and the Ink app: add optional DashboardData fields so hand-built test fixtures stay valid; snapshotKey in the legacy path may stay unchanged. Ink tests: call installTerminalSizeMock() (test/helpers/mock-terminal-size.ts) and prefer waitForFrame polling over fixed ticks; disambiguate lastFrame() line matching when a substring appears in multiple sections (scripts/cam/patterns.md, 2026-07-07 bullets). formatWallClock lives in src/commands/status.ts. If a state-file frontmatter field is added, update templates/ and run bun run embed-vendor. Strict TS with noUncheckedIndexedAccess.

userStories.title: Accumulate session worker-token total from the event log and render it in the dashboard header
userStories.description: As a cam operator, I need the dashboard to show the cumulative token spend of all workers in the current session so that I have cost visibility during prolonged autonomous runs and know when to stop.
acceptanceCriteria: A pure exported helper sums worker 'tokens' events (all four TokensEventDetail fields: inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheReadTokens, cacheCreationTokens) from the event-log JSONL, counting only events at-or-after the session start; malformed lines are skipped; a missing log yields no total. [oracle: bun test]
'cycle-tokens' aggregate events are excluded from the session total so worker spend is never double-counted. [oracle: bun test]
readSnapshot exposes the session-cumulative worker token total as an optional DashboardData field; the value is expressed in tokens, never USD. [oracle: bun test]

The Dashboard Loop header renders the session token total alongside the existing status/branch rows, using the shared token formatting helpers; the row is omitted or shows a muted placeholder when no tokens events fall inside the session window. [oracle: bun test test/dashboard.test.ts]
Verify the screen renders correctly (ink-testing-library; state is signalled by the glyph, never by divider color). [oracle: bun test]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Full quality spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/commands/dashboard.ts (pure parser next to parseRecentProgress + readSnapshot wiring + DashboardData field), src/ui/Dashboard.tsx (SummaryPanel row), test/dashboard.test.ts. Event log: .claude/cam-worker-events.jsonl (EVENT_LOG_PATH in dashboard.ts); TokensEventDetail shape lives in src/supervisor/events.ts. Precedent: recordCycleTokens (src/commands/journal.ts; scripts/cam/patterns.md CAM-131 bullet) sums all four fields of worker 'tokens' events; match that formula. The event log is cumulative across cycles and PRDs and is never truncated, so the sum MUST be bounded by the US-001 session start (ts >= sessionStart), never the whole file. Display: reuse renderTokensLine / formatTokens from src/transcript/usage.ts so the wording matches the existing orchestrator tokens row. Cost stays in tokens, not USD (settled in the issue spec: price varies by model/tier). Mirror parseRecentProgress error handling: skip malformed lines, never crash the dashboard. Depends on US-001 for the session-start boundary. Strict TS with noUncheckedIndexedAccess.
